data.name: MilkTea Time
data.detailed_description:
"Milk Tea Time" It's time to own the bubble tea shop of your dreams! Here, you can not only make bubble tea with your own hands, but also unleash your creativity to invent wild recipes and turn your little shop into the coolest bubble tea spot on the block!

✧ You Are the Chosen One of Bubble Tea ✧

As the shop owner, you’re in charge of everything—taking orders, crafting drinks, and packing them up, all in one seamless flow! Just remember: a customer’s patience sinks faster than pearls in milk tea. Your speed will determine whether your shop gets five-star reviews or… well, let’s just say the opposite 😉

🛒 Stock Up Like a Pro, Open Up Like a Boss 🛒

Make sure you’ve stocked up on tea, milk, sugar, and pearls ahead of time—don’t wait until there’s a line out the door to realize… oops, the coconut jelly’s all gone! Start your day at your own pace, hit “Open for Business,” and then… brace yourself for the tap-tap-tapping chaos!

🧪 The Bubble Tea Lab Is Now Open 🧪

Experiment with new recipes and mix up mysterious flavors! Will it be taro bubble milk reigning supreme, or mint coffee making a surprise entrance? You call the shots! Go wild with hundreds of ingredients and create your very own “questionable” specials—mango mixed with coffee? cheese foam with chili? If you can imagine it, you can brew it! Complete mini-games, unlock hidden potential, and who knows—your creation might just go viral!

🏡 Design Freedom—Your Style, Your Rules 🏡

From the floor tiles to the pendant lights, from the shop layout to every tiny decoration—every choice reflects your unique taste and creativity! Turn your shop into an Instagram-worthy hotspot where customers come not just for the tea… but to chill and share stories all day long!

👥 Meet Your Bubble Tea Mentors & Tasty Challenges 👥

Friendly NPCs will act as your bubble tea gurus, guiding you from newbie to shake master. Meanwhile, picky foodies will throw tricky orders your way—take on their challenges, earn rare ingredients, and always stay one recipe ahead of the trend!

🗺️ Uncle’s Hunting for Recipes—Around the World He Goes! 🗺️

Support your adventure-loving uncle as he travels the globe in search of tea inspiration! Hunting for mysterious toppings in hidden valleys? Seeking the finest milk from highland pastures? All to uncover the legendary “glow-in-the-dark” ultimate recipe! Oh, and don’t forget to fund his trips—those plane tickets aren’t cheap, you know 😉

Research new flavors to win customer praise. Build and decorate your milk tea shop by hand. Create your own beautiful milk tea shop!
